dispute.category_label: Product not as advertised / misleading listing

issue_details: I bought a smartwatch for Rs 6,999 on TrendCart because the listing said it was waterproof (5ATM) and had built-in GPS. The watch I received has no GPS and the box says only splash resistant.
what_happened: I bought a smartwatch for Rs 6,999 on TrendCart because the listing said it was waterproof (5ATM) and had built-in GPS. The watch I received has no GPS and the box says only splash resistant.
what_was_expected: A smartwatch with the features and characteristics stated in the listing / advertisement.
steps_taken: I raised a return request on 24 October 2026 in the app; it was rejected the same day.
seller_response: The seller refused to accept a return, saying the product is as per description. I raised a return request on 24 October 2026 in the app; it was rejected the same day.
